top.heading: Phone visitors can't tap to call you
top.body: We did not find a tap-to-call phone link on your homepage.
top.fix: Make your phone number a tap-to-call link and put it at the top of the page.

top.heading: Your site shows more than one phone number
top.body: We found 2 different phone numbers across the 3 pages we checked.
top.fix: Use one main number everywhere, so nobody calls the wrong line.

top.heading: There is no clear first step at the top of the page
top.body: On your homepage: "Call us at (316) 555-0142". The only way to act sits at the bottom of the page.
top.fix: Pick one action (call, book or get a quote) and make it the main button at the top.

working.text: You've been in business since 1998, which builds trust.
You back every roof with a 10-year workmanship warranty.
You show real volume: over 2,400 roofs replaced.
Visitors can send you a request from the homepage.
The homepage asks visitors to take a next step.

journey.text: A visitor lands on your name as the headline and has to scroll to learn you do roofs.
They meet a stock line before any proof, so the first impression is generic.
journey.quote: We are a trusted, dedicated team committed to quality service.

journey.text: The strongest proof, 2,400 roofs and a 10-year warranty, sits mid-page.
journey.quote: Over 2,400 roofs replaced across Wichita and Derby.

journey.text: Ready to act, they find two phone numbers and wonder which one to call.
On the contact page, an eight-field form slows down anyone ready to book.
journey.quote: We usually reply within one business day.

verdict: You've been in business since 1998, which builds trust.
The biggest gap: phone visitors can't tap to call you.

report.rule: How we graded this: 12 areas, 100 points, scored only from what anyone can see from the outside: up to 8 pages of your site, its robots.txt, sitemap and llms.txt files, and the public email records for your domain. Each item is a pass, a partial or a miss. A is 90 or more, B 80 to 89, C 70 to 79, D 60 to 69, F under 60. Items we could not check are left out of the score and named.
report.scoreLabel: The grade is ProyTech's score for these checks on this date. It does not come from Google or any rating body.
